tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'chi med 'phags ma'i snying tig gi dngos grub len pa'i bzlas dmigs ni/ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re sarba maṇ+ḍal phaṭa dzaḥ zhes dzab khang phye ba sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de las 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ 'khor 'das kyi dwangs bcud thams cad bsdus te dkyil 'khor pa'i thugs kar thim/ dngos grub stsol ba la mngon du phyogs pas ye shes kyi gzi byin 'bar bzhin bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re hrīḥbh+rūm̐ḥbadz+ra dz+nyā na ā yu ṣe swā hā: oṃ aḥhūm̐ swā hāḥ mum̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: sarba ta thā ga tā ā yur+dz+nyā na ma hā puṇ+ye tiṣ+ṭha oṃ: kā ya wā' ka tsit+ta gu ṇa karma sarba sid+dhi pha la ho: zhes stong rtsa sogs ci nus su bzla/ ༈ /dgongs gter sgrol dkar 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying tig skor la dbang/ khrid/ lung gsum/ dang po ni/ rtsa dbang ye shes thig le'i steng nas sta gon dang 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs/ yang zab tshe'i byin rlabs kyi steng nas sngon 'gro dang bum dbang gis gzhi dgod/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu dang bcas pa la brten nas dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur/ tshe 'brang gyis rgyas gdab pa bcas/ thun mong tshe'i rjes gnang gi steng nas gsol 'debs/ tshogs bsags/ ye shes dbab brtan/ tshe 'gugs bcas kyi rjes sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang dbang bskur bcas/ zhar byung sa gter yongs rdzogs 'chi med snying tig gi gtor dbang phyag len ltar/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor phyag rgya gcig pa'i steng nas lha khrid mdor bsdus/ gsum pa ni/ phrin las ye shes snang ba/ rtsa dbang ye shes thig le/ yang zab tshe'i byin rlabs/ thun mong tshe'i rjes gnang bcas gzhung dang*/ bsnyen sgrub kyi dris lan nyung ngu*/
'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyi gsung brgyud 'debs/ mchod phreng*/ sman mchod/ zhar byung sa gter tshe sgrub rdo rje phreng ba'i chos sde yongs rdzogs 'chi med snying tig bcas so// //
